verdict.rationale: GitHub maintains an official repository of OpenAPI descriptions for its REST API, declared stable and generally available. It ships both a 3.0 version and a 3.1 version, and the GraphQL schema has documented reference docs. The probe's 404s on docs.github.com paths only show the spec isn't served at conventional discovery URLs; they don't contradict the published spec. Missing for 10: discoverability at a well-known/docs-hosted OpenAPI URL, independent hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.
